امتثلتما (form VIII)
# اِمْتَثَلْتُمَا (imtaṯaltumā) /im.ta.θal.tu.maː/: second-person dual past active of اِمْتَثَلَ (imtaṯala)
# اُمْتُثِلْتُمَا (umtuṯiltumā) /um.tu.θil.tu.maː/: second-person dual past passive of اِمْتَثَلَ (imtaṯala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
